page_title: AI builder that gets down to business

summary.name: Makedraft
summary.one_liner: Makedraft is an AI app builder that creates real code in your own GitHub repo on a real branch, deployed as you chat, for React and Next.js projects.
use_cases: Building a React or Next.js app through chat
Prototyping a web project that lives in your own GitHub repo
Deploying an AI-generated app to Render
Wiring up Supabase or Stripe in a generated project
summary.what_it_does: The page says each chat session produces real code in the user's own repository, on a real branch, and already deployed, with no sandbox or export step. It states it works with React and Next.js projects. It lists GitHub, Render, Supabase and Stripe as the tools it runs on. The page also shows a set of example builder projects with view and like style counts, but gives no details about them.
notable: Writes code directly to your own GitHub repo on a real branch, no export step
Each chat is deployed as it goes, via Render
caveats: Only React and Next.js projects are mentioned as supported
Pricing is not stated on the page
